name: Amram Avraham Construction Company Ltd
summary: Amram Avraham Construction Company Ltd operated private construction projects in Israel. The company operates in two segments, the Residential Construction in Israel and the Investment Real Estate for Commerce, Industry and Warehousing. It develops and constructs residential and mixed-use projects. The company also develops and operates hotels and offices. In addition, it engages in locating, initiating, establishing, renting, and managing real estate for investment, industrial, warehousing, logistics, Industry, storage, logistics, trade, offices, or hotels. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Hadera, Israel.
